Dear [Mr Coleridge](/person/336)
Thank you much for kindly remembering me on this occasion but I do not think I shall be in London at the time.[^1]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: CMY is declining an invitation to Westminster Abbey to witness the unveiling by James Russell Lowell of a bust of [Samuel Taylor Coleridge](/person/1667) on 7 May 1885.
